tasks.name: inbox
tasks.description:
Identify what kind of document this image is and put it in metadata as {"category": "general_receipt" | "medical_receipt" | "non_receipt", "summary": "one sentence"}.

Rules:
- "medical_receipt": Receipts, bills, invoices from clinics, TCM (Traditional Chinese Medicine) practitioners, hospitals, dental, pharmacies, or any medical diagnosis document (like Medical Certificate / MC). Also include bank transfer screenshots where the payee is a medical clinic or doctor (e.g. Great Wall TCM, Family Clinic, etc.).
- "general_receipt": Any standard retail, dining, food court, supermarket, taxi, transport receipts, or general banking transfer screenshots to non-medical payees.
- "non_receipt": Any image that is not a receipt, bill, invoice, medical certificate, or payment transaction slip.

targets.name: general_inbox
targets.description: Ordinary receipts not yet extracted: retail, dining, food court, supermarket, taxi, transport, or bank transfers to non-medical payees. Use for a classify result of general_receipt.

targets.name: medical_inbox
targets.description: Medical documents not yet extracted: clinic, TCM, hospital, dental or pharmacy receipts, medical certificates (MC), or bank transfers to a clinic or doctor. Use for a classify result of medical_receipt.

targets.name: special_inbox
targets.description: Documents that are not receipts but are records worth keeping, such as letters, statements, contracts or certificates. Not for ordinary photos or screenshots.

tasks.name: general
tasks.description:
Analyze this general receipt image. This is a general receipt from retail, dining, food, travel, or supermarket.

Put these fields in metadata:
{
  "category": "general_receipt",
  "date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "time": "HH:MM",
  "merchant": "merchant_name_lowercase_underscore_separated",
  "merchant_uen": "uen_or_na",
  "payment_method": "payment_method",
  "reference_no": "reference_number_or_na",
  "items": [
    {
      "name": "string",
      "qty": 1,
      "unit_price": 0.00,
      "total_price": 0.00
    }
  ],
  "currency": "lowercase_3_letter_currency_code",
  "subtotal": 0.00,
  "gst": 0.00,
  "rounding": 0.00,
  "total_amount": 0.00
}

Rules:
- category: MUST be "general_receipt".
- date: YYYY-MM-DD (Gregorian), extract the transaction date.
- Taiwan receipts print the year in the 民國 (ROC) era: a 2-3 digit year such as "115/02/23", "1150223" or "民國115年2月23日". Convert it by ADDING 1911 (115 -> 2026, 104 -> 2015). Never read a 3-digit era year as a Gregorian year.
- time: HH:MM or "N/A" if not visible.
- merchant: The payee or merchant name, MUST be formatted as lowercase, words separated by underscores (e.g. "md40", "ah_luck_six", "citadines_kitchens").
- merchant_uen: The UEN/Registration ID of the merchant (if visible, e.g. "201725438K") or "N/A".
- payment_method: The payment method (e.g. "PayNow", "Visa", "NETS", "Cash") or "N/A".
- reference_no: The transaction reference number, STAN ID, or trace ID (if visible) or "N/A".
- items: An array containing each purchased item. If individual items are not listed (like in bank transfer slips), return an empty array `[]`.
- currency: lowercase 3-letter currency code (e.g. "sgd", "usd", "twd").
- subtotal: The subtotal amount before tax/GST (if visible as a number, e.g. 12.50) or 0.00.
- gst: The tax or GST amount (if visible, e.g. 1.13) or 0.00.
- rounding: The rounding adjustment (if visible, e.g. -0.02) or 0.00.
- total_amount: The final paid amount (decimal string or number, no currency symbol, e.g. 12.50).

targets.name: general_archive
targets.description: Extracted ordinary receipts that have a merchant, date and amount.

tasks.name: medical
tasks.description:
Analyze this medical receipt or medical certificate image. This is from a clinic, doctor, Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) practitioner, hospital, or pharmacy.

Put these fields in metadata:
{
  "category": "medical_receipt",
  "date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "time": "HH:MM",
  "clinic_name": "clinic_name_lowercase_underscore_separated",
  "clinic_uen": "uen_or_na",
  "patient_name": "patient_name",
  "patient_id": "patient_id_or_na",
  "doctor_name": "doctor_name_or_na",
  "doctor_mcr": "doctor_mcr_or_na",
  "invoice_no": "invoice_no_or_na",
  "receipt_no": "receipt_no_or_na",
  "payment_method": "payment_method",
  "items": [
    {
      "name": "string",
      "qty": 1,
      "unit_price": 0.00,
      "total_price": 0.00
    }
  ],
  "currency": "lowercase_3_letter_currency_code",
  "subtotal": 0.00,
  "gst": 0.00,
  "rounding": 0.00,
  "total_amount": 0.00,
  "is_medical_certificate": true/false,
  "mc_start_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",
  "mc_end_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",
  "mc_days": 1 or null,
  "diagnosis": "string or null"
}

Rules:
- category: MUST be "medical_receipt".
- date: YYYY-MM-DD (Gregorian). Extract the invoice date or the date the document was issued (e.g. 看診日期, 就醫日期, 開立日期).
- Taiwan documents print the year in the 民國 (ROC) era: a 2-3 digit year such as "115/02/23", "1150223" or "民國115年2月23日". Convert it by ADDING 1911 (115 -> 2026, 104 -> 2015). Never read a 3-digit era year as a Gregorian year, and never reuse the patient birth year (生日, also printed in ROC era) as the visit date.
- time: HH:MM or "N/A" if not visible.
- clinic_name: The clinic or hospital name EXACTLY as printed in the document header, transliterated; never guess a sibling branch of the same hospital group. MUST be formatted as lowercase, words separated by underscores (e.g. "great_wall_tcm", "my_family_clinic", "wanfang_hospital").
- clinic_uen: The UEN/Registration ID of the clinic (if visible, e.g. "201725438K") or "N/A". A Taiwan 批價序號 / 收據號碼 / 醫令序號 is a document serial number, not a UEN — put it in receipt_no and return "N/A" here.
- patient_name: The patient name (if visible, e.g. "Liu Teng-Yuan") or "N/A". On Chinese documents this is the 姓名 / 病患姓名 field, NOT the 醫師 field.
- patient_id: The patient's NRIC/ID number (if visible, e.g. "S8669082I") or "N/A". On Taiwan documents use the 身分證 number; if only 病歷號 is printed use that.
- doctor_name: The doctor/physician/consultant's name (if visible) or "N/A". On Chinese documents this is the 醫師 / 主治醫師 field.
- doctor_mcr: The doctor's Medical Council Registration (MCR) number (if visible, e.g. "M04788J") or "N/A". A Taiwan 病歷號 belongs to the patient, never here.
- invoice_no: The invoice number (if visible, e.g. "IN74687") or "N/A".
- receipt_no: The receipt number (if visible, e.g. "RT-TLH0073009") or "N/A".
- payment_method: The payment method (e.g. "PayNow", "NETS", "Visa", "Cash") or "N/A".
- items: An array containing medical items, consultation fees, or prescriptions. For Medical Certificates or bank slips, this can be empty `[]`.
- currency: lowercase 3-letter currency code (e.g. "sgd", "usd", "twd").
- subtotal: Subtotal amount before GST (if visible, default 0.00).
- gst: GST amount (if visible, default 0.00).
- rounding: Rounding adjustments (if visible, default 0.00).
- total_amount: The final amount paid. If this is a Medical Certificate (MC) with no charge, or a consultation tax invoice showing $0.00, return 0.00.
- is_medical_certificate: true if the document is a Medical Certificate (MC/Unfit for work certificate). otherwise false.
- mc_start_date: YYYY-MM-DD, the start date of medical leave (if this is an MC) or null.
- mc_end_date: YYYY-MM-DD, the end date of medical leave (if this is an MC) or null.
- mc_days: The number of days of medical leave (if this is an MC) or null.
- diagnosis: The diagnosis or reason for consultation (if visible, e.g. "左侧落枕3天" or "左膝内侧痛。") or "N/A".

targets.name: medical_archive
targets.description: Extracted medical receipts or medical certificates that have a clinic and date.

tasks.name: special
tasks.description:
Analyze this document image. It is a record worth keeping that is not a receipt, such as a letter, bank or utility statement, contract, insurance policy, tax notice or certificate.

Put these fields in metadata:
{
  "date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "document_type": "letter | statement | contract | insurance | tax | certificate | other",
  "issuer": "organisation or person that issued the document",
  "title": "the document's own title or subject line",
  "summary": "one sentence on what the document is about"
}

Rules:
- date: the date printed on the document (issue, statement or letter date), not today's date.
- issuer and title: copy them as printed; use "N/A" when not visible.

targets.name: special_archive
targets.description: Documents worth keeping that are not receipts, filed by their own date.
